body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: cut**

The code says it all: k_plane_t is the packed plane type, make_unique<k_plane_t[]>(NKV) is one plane per head, and the loop at 878-882 stores the row of every token t < gof_tokens. The static_assert message at 849-850 already states that one packed plane holds every staged token.

Proposed: cut the comment.
